title: Who We Are
text: The Caltech Bioinformatics Research Center develops bioinformatics workflows, facilitates the analysis of biological data, benchmarks methods, and provides bioinformatics and statistics consulting. The center supports projects involving both technology development and biological discovery, with current emphasis on bioinformatics for genomics, transcriptomics, and epigenomics.

title: Get In Touch
text:
Get In Touch
We welcome inquiries from Caltech students, postdocs, and faculty who are interested in biological data analysis or need assistance setting up a data analysis workflow.


Location: BCK 340  Email: bioinformatics@caltech.edu


Before starting your experiment, we request that you meet with us to go over your experiment goals. This helps ensure you get the most out of your data.
If you’re seeking help with a project, please include:

A short description of your research question

The type of data (e.g., scRNA-seq, bulk RNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics)

What stage your project is in and what you’d like help with

We recommend that you view our tutorial page before contacting us.

title: Our Mission
text:
The Caltech Bioinformatics Research Center (CBRC) supports the Caltech research community in bioinformatics and computational biology.
Our mission is to: - Enable reproducible and scalable data analysis workflows
- Train graduate students in single-cell genomics, bulk RNA-seq, and spatial transcriptomics
- Provide consulting and mentorship in computational best practices
By fostering open science and collaboration, CBRC helps transform complex biological data into meaningful discoveries.

Caltech Bioinformatics Resource Center



At the Caltech Bioinformatics Resource Center, we’re here to make computational biology approachable. Whether you’re just starting your first single-cell RNA-seq project or refining your analysis workflow, we’ll help you find the right tools and methods for your research — and understand why they work.

title: Caltech Bioinformatics Research Center
text:
About CBRC
The Caltech Bioinformatics Research Center (CBRC) supports researchers and graduate students in developing computational biology pipelines, mastering data analysis, and applying current best practices in single-cell genomics, bulk RNA-seq, and spatial transcriptomics.
We are dedicated to fostering a culture of open, reproducible, and collaborative science within the Caltech community.
